# Rory Phillips, AI for owner-managed businesses

> Practical AI implementation for UK owner-managed businesses: a free AI readiness assessment, fixed-price audits, team training and a fractional AI officer retainer, with sector pages for construction, manufacturing and distribution, plus website concept builds for fictional clinic, roofing, restaurant, agency, ecommerce and electrical businesses.

Pages describe services and typical outcomes in general terms. No client results are guaranteed.

## Services

- [Rory Phillips: hand-coded websites that load in under a second](https://roryphillips.dev/): Hand-coded websites for small businesses, and fractional AI officer services for established UK companies. Sub-second loads, no templates, automations priced in £/month saved.
- [Fractional AI Officer for UK businesses: Rory Phillips](https://roryphillips.dev/fractional-ai-officer/): Fractional AI officer for owner-managed UK businesses. I automate quoting, reporting and invoice-chasing, and train your team to run it: priced in £/month saved.
- [AI systems for owner-managed UK businesses: Rory Phillips](https://roryphillips.dev/services/): I find the manual work inside your business, price it in £/month, and install the systems that remove it. Free readiness check, £3,500 audit, fractional AI officer retainers from £4,500/mo.
- [AI Readiness Audit](https://roryphillips.dev/assessment/)
- [AI field notes: Rory Phillips](https://roryphillips.dev/ai-notes/): Working notes from helping owner-managed UK businesses put AI to work: automations built, hours saved, honest numbers, and the occasional dead end.
- [Speed Rescue: a real speed-audit sample](https://roryphillips.dev/speed-rescue/): In July 2026 I audited 50+ UK trades websites on mobile. A third scored under 60/100. See the real numbers, a real sample breakdown, and get yours free.

## Sector pages

- [AI for construction firms in the UK: Rory Phillips](https://roryphillips.dev/ai-for-construction/): Fractional AI officer for UK construction and civils firms. I automate tender assembly, valuations, RAMS and site reporting: priced in £/month saved.
- [AI for UK manufacturers: Made Smarter ready, Rory Phillips](https://roryphillips.dev/ai-for-manufacturing/): Fractional AI officer for UK manufacturers: automating quoting, purchase orders, production reporting and stock paperwork, audits Made Smarter grant-ready.
- [AI for UK wholesalers, distributors and hauliers: Rory Phillips](https://roryphillips.dev/ai-for-distribution/): Fractional AI officer for UK wholesalers, distributors and hauliers: automating order processing, supplier invoices and POD paperwork, priced in £/month saved.

## Concept builds (invented businesses, not real companies)

Demo websites built to show design and front-end work. Every business name, address, price, review and phone number on these pages is made up. None of them is a real company, and they are not meant to appear in search results.

- [Dental clinic demo (fictional "Lakeline Dental Studio")](https://roryphillips.dev/clinic-us/): Concept site for an invented dental practice in Austin, Texas, with published prices and an emergency booking flow.
- [Heritage roofing demo (fictional "Ridge & Beam")](https://roryphillips.dev/roofing-uk/): Concept site for an invented roofing firm in York, covering slate and pantile work, leadwork and listed building consent.
- [Restaurant demo (fictional "API API")](https://roryphillips.dev/restaurant/): Concept site for an invented wood-fire restaurant in Kuala Lumpur, with menu, opening hours and a booking section.
- [Design studio demo (fictional "Studio Kilat")](https://roryphillips.dev/agency/): Concept site for an invented two-person brand and web studio in Kuala Lumpur, with case studies and a contact section.
- [Online shop demo (fictional "TANAH" coffee)](https://roryphillips.dev/ecommerce/): Concept shop for an invented Liberica coffee roaster in Johor, with a shop section and a working demo cart.
- [Instant quote calculator demo (fictional "Ampere & Sons")](https://roryphillips.dev/calculator/): A working instant-quote tool on a concept site for an invented Manchester electrician, giving itemised estimates for rewires, consumer units and EV chargers.
